rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:15 as anti-flood, used the customer's evidence (water in tray, glued plinth, tablets only, recurrence after a 24h dry-out) and steered towards an engineer with useful handover details, without naming a part to buy. It stayed appropriately uncertain about the leak source. Weaknesses: it repeated drying and re-running advice that the recurrence had already undermined, suggested re-running a cycle after drying and checking spray arms before booking, and asked about the warranty without using the 3.5-year age. It also repeated similar hedged cause lists across turns.
